Author: Edualc
Name: Gil Tracker
Description: A merchant's ledger for your wallet. Tracks the gil you earn and spend by source (market board, vendors, duties, FATEs, treasure maps, quests, trades, housing, repairs, teleports and more) for this session, today, the last 7 days, and all time, with a 14 day chart and a gil per hour rate. Market board sales are counted when you visit a summoning bell. Open it with /gil.
Punchline: See how much gil you make and spend, and exactly where it comes from.

Author: Edualc
Name: Wondrous Tails Advisor
Description: A little sticker book helper for Khloe's journal. Pick your goal (any line, two lines, or the jackpot) and it reads your journal to give you one clear call: Keep stamping, Shake it up, Grab more points, or Off to Khloe, with a one line reason using your real odds. Open it with /wta or just open your journal.
Punchline: Your Wondrous Tails buddy: tells you when to shake up your journal and when to keep stamping.
